verdicts.reason: A has a strong headline hierarchy, but 'ANTHONY'/'CHURCH' run almost to the canvas edges. The invite copy is a cramped, choppy centred stack, while the dates and 'WORSHIP & BIBLE STUDY' drift left off the centre axis. All the text is crammed into the top 60% of the canvas, which leaves a big dead gap above a tiny illustration. B breaks the content into scattered fragments separated by large arbitrary gaps. Its alignment is inconsistent: the cross is centred, the worship line is left-aligned and the dates are ragged. It also orphans 'DRAKE', and the shrunken hiker illustration loses its impact, so it reads as less intentional than A.
